entries.message: Crest no longer quits when you clear or close the last open pages of a Chromium Space with Chromium's Contextual Tasks flag turned on.

Clear now keeps the tab you're on and archives your other open tabs. On Mac, hold Option to turn it into Clear All. Clear All Tabs, Option-Shift-Command-K, is also in the Tabs menu, the command palette and the Space's ••• menu, which is where iPhone and iPad find it.
